The unsuffixed raw record provides no reliable discriminator, so neither identity can be selected safely.

profiles.shortDescription: Börger develops and manufactures rotary lobe pumps for industrial and environmental fluid-handling duties. Its modular BLUEline and ONIXline ranges include stationary, mobile and application-configured pump units.
fullDescription: Börger GmbH is a German manufacturer based in Borken-Weseke. The company documents its origins in 1975 and develops rotary lobe pump technology for handling liquids, viscous media and fluids containing solids.

Its official material describes self-priming, valveless positive-displacement pumps built around a modular configuration. The portfolio includes BLUEline and ONIXline pump families, with stationary, mobile and ATEX-compliant assemblies configured for the operating medium and installation. A Ventrovia request can specify flow, pressure, viscosity, solids content, temperature, materials and mounting arrangement.

profiles.shortDescription: Bürkle develops and manufactures sampling, liquid-transfer and laboratory equipment. Its range includes samplers, sampling systems, drum and container pumps, filling devices, containers and industrial laboratory accessories.
fullDescription: Bürkle GmbH is a German manufacturer based in Bad Bellingen. Its official range is organised around professional sampling, controlled liquid transfer and equipment for laboratories, production facilities and quality-control operations.

Product groups include sampling lances, vacuum samplers, scoops and specialised samplers for liquids, powders and viscous materials; barrel, container, dosage, diaphragm and magnetic centrifugal pumps; filling and dispensing devices; bottles, canisters and other containers; and laboratory accessories. Ventrovia enquiries can identify the medium, container type, sampling method, chemical compatibility, required volume and hygiene or safety constraints.

profiles.shortDescription: C&G Depurazione Industriale designs and builds systems for treating, recovering and recycling industrial wastewater. Its technologies include vacuum evaporators, ion-exchange and demineralisation plants, ultrafiltration, reverse osmosis and other industrial filtration systems.
fullDescription: C&G Depurazione Industriale S.r.l. is an Italian engineering company based in Rignano sull'Arno near Florence. The official company profile states that it has operated in industrial wastewater treatment since 1971 and designs complete systems from project definition through installation.

The manufacturer documents vacuum evaporators, including V-NT, scraped, ES Dry and multi-effect configurations; ion-exchange and demineralisation plants; ultrafiltration and reverse-osmosis systems; carbon and absorption filters; filter presses and equipment for treatment and liquid recovery. Ventrovia enquiries can define wastewater composition, target recovery, flow, discharge limits, concentration duty and site constraints.

profiles.shortDescription: C.E.B. Impianti designs, manufactures and installs industrial container-washing and decontamination systems. Its range covers low- and high-pressure, hot-water, solvent and closed-loop washing solutions for tanks, IBCs, drums and other process containers.
fullDescription: C.E.B. Impianti S.r.l. is an Italian manufacturer based in Barzanò. The company has designed and built automated industrial container-washing systems since 1997, supporting installation, testing and maintenance at customer sites.

Official information covers low- and high-pressure washing with water or solvents, hot washing and closed-loop systems with filtration, as well as open-loop arrangements where the process requires them. The machines handle fixed and mixing tanks, IBCs, drums, pails, cans and other industrial containers. Applications include chemicals, coatings, silicones, resins, inks, adhesives, food, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, oil and gas, waste and packaging recovery.

profiles.shortDescription: Cabur manufactures industrial electrical connectivity, automation, control and marking equipment. Its portfolio includes terminal blocks, power supplies, protection and signal-conditioning modules, relays, industrial marking systems and components for photovoltaic and e-mobility installations.
fullDescription: Cabur S.r.l. is an Italian electrical-equipment manufacturer based in Altare. Its official site records activity in electrical-panel connections since 1952 and organises the portfolio around industrial connectivity, automation and control, industrial marking and energy-transition solutions.

The range includes push-in, spring-clamp, screw, modular and bolt terminal blocks; industrial power supplies, protective devices, EMI filters, signal converters, UPS equipment and relay interfaces; SmartPrint+, Caburjet and SmartRoll+ marking systems; and photovoltaic string boxes, connectors, surge-protection devices and e-mobility components. Ventrovia enquiries can identify voltage, current, connection technology, channel count, mounting and required approvals.

profiles.shortDescription: Caffini Pumps manufactures self-priming diaphragm and centrifugal pumps. Libellula diaphragm pumps handle viscous or solids-laden liquids, while TrashLib centrifugal pumps are designed for loaded water containing sludge, sand and suspended solids.
fullDescription: Caffini Cipriano S.r.l. is an Italian pump manufacturer based in Lemignano di Collecchio near Parma. Its dedicated Caffini Pumps site documents two principal self-priming pump technologies for transfer, drainage and demanding liquid-handling applications.

The Libellula family comprises diaphragm pumps intended for thick, abrasive or solids-containing liquids where high discharge pressure is not required. TrashLib centrifugal pumps provide tool-free access to the impeller and front cover and are used for loaded water containing sludge, sand and solids. A Ventrovia enquiry can specify liquid composition, required flow and head, solids size, suction lift, drive and installation type.

profiles.shortDescription: Caldaro develops custom industrial human-machine control components. Its product range includes full-grip, palm-grip and fingertip joysticks, industrial pedals, position sensors and marine controls.
fullDescription: Caldaro AB is a Swedish industrial-controls company headquartered in Stockholm. The manufacturer develops customer-adapted control components that connect operators with machinery and equipment.

Its official product structure includes full-grip, palm-grip and fingertip industrial joysticks, pedals for demanding operating environments, position sensors and customised marine controls. Published application areas include agriculture, construction equipment, cranes, forestry, industrial machinery, maritime and offshore systems, material handling, medical equipment and mining. Ventrovia enquiries can specify axes, electrical output, grip or pedal configuration, environmental conditions and machine interface.

profiles.shortDescription: Cameron is an SLB product family for oil-and-gas flow and pressure control. Its current official portfolio includes production and frac valves, frac trees and manifolds, pressure-control equipment, metering systems and well-safety systems.
fullDescription: Cameron is maintained by SLB as a product family for drilling, completions, production and midstream flow-control applications. Manufacturer-owned SLB pages identify Cameron as the OEM for multiple equipment families rather than as an independent current corporate entity.

The documented portfolio includes ball, butterfly, check, gate, plug and diverter valves, chokes and valve actuators; frac valves, frac trees and zipper manifolds; annular blowout preventers and related drilling pressure-control equipment; hydrocarbon metering systems; and wellhead safety and shutdown systems. Ventrovia enquiries can specify equipment type, size, pressure rating, material, service medium, connection and operating environment.

profiles.shortDescription: Camfil manufactures clean-air and air-pollution-control systems. Its portfolio includes general-ventilation, HEPA and ULPA, high-temperature and molecular filters, air cleaners, dust and fume collectors, housings and turbomachinery intake filtration.
fullDescription: Camfil AB is a Swedish clean-air technology manufacturer founded in 1963. The repository name Camfil Farr is retained as a former name: Camfil's official history records the acquisition of Farr Company, while the current commercial identity and website use Camfil.

The official portfolio covers general ventilation filters, EPA, HEPA and ULPA filters, high-temperature filters, molecular filtration, air cleaners and purifiers, dust, fume and mist collectors, filter housings and frames, and turbomachinery filters and inlet systems. These technologies serve commercial ventilation, clean processes, life sciences, healthcare, energy, material processing and other industrial air-quality duties.
